实验运行环境说明：当前工作目录为 /workspace，输入文件已经放在相应相对路径。请实际完成用户任务，必要时调用工具；不要仅描述做法。生成的交付文件放在 /workspace/outputs。可以使用 exec 运行 Python、Node、LibreOffice、pandoc、PDF工具、Tesseract、ffmpeg、Chromium/Playwright。Python虚拟环境已在PATH，中文字体为Noto Sans CJK SC，可通过fc-match定位实际字体文件。Office公式应通过LibreOffice实际重算。填写可编辑PDF文本表单可用 python /opt/eval-adapter/pdf_form.py INPUT.pdf VALUES.json OUTPUT.pdf --receipt RECEIPT.json；VALUES.json是实际字段名到文字值的JSON对象，该通用工具生成嵌入中文字体的字段外观并保留可编辑字段；完成后需实际渲染检查显示文字，不能仅检查字段值或文件存在。以下命令客户端（包括local-asr、remotion和ecnu_tools.py）均通过exec执行，不是额外的原生工具名。要用原生view_image查看的渲染图请写入/workspace/tmp（先创建目录）或/tmp/openclaw；已有其他/tmp路径的图先复制到/workspace/tmp再查看。Playwright Chromium executable_path=/usr/bin/chromium，launch args=["--no-sandbox"]。原生browser本地网页请先启动HTTP服务并使用http://127.0.0.1地址；file:页面用Playwright。Remotion、React和CLI已安装，可直接 remotion render，指定 --browser-executable=/usr/bin/chromium；无需重复安装同套依赖。网络访问可用；用户要求下载的材料和skills请在任务中真实下载。当前ecnu-plus的文本与图片理解已通过独立接口探针；未提供额外搜索API密钥；公开网页可使用browser或HTTP读取。图像生成命令是 python /opt/eval-adapter/ecnu_tools.py image --text "图片描述" --output /workspace/outputs/结果.png；中文语音命令是 python /opt/eval-adapter/ecnu_tools.py speech --text "需要朗读的内容" --output /workspace/outputs/结果.wav；独立图片理解可调用该helper的 vision --image-path "图片路径" --text "问题" --output /workspace/outputs/说明.txt。helper自行读取私有模型凭据，禁止读取或展示密钥；本地离线中文语音识别可运行 local-asr "输入音频路径" --language zh --output /workspace/outputs/识别结果.json。工具执行成功与否以本次实际结果为准。不得假装调用未配置的外部服务。未提供的私人文件/企业账号请明确说明。已发现的skills按原生skills规则读取后再使用，不能把标题当作已读正文。

公开参考skill的实际目录是 /workspace/skills/<名称>，脚本相对该skill根解析。兼容目录 /workspace/.claude/skills 指向同一目录；CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=/workspace。需要CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR的命令可用exec运行 python /opt/eval-adapter/runtime_compat.py run-skill --skill <名称> -- <命令及参数>，该变量只针对本条命令，不在多个skill之间共享固定值。跨包参考正文如果本题准入，会放在 /workspace/reference_support，作为依赖资料而非新增active skill；可运行 python /opt/eval-adapter/runtime_compat.py reference-path --skill <名称> --reference "<SKILL中原相对引用>" 查询真实存在的位置，再用read读取；不存在就报告缺项。GetNotes参考SDK的原缓存含跨平台开发依赖，从该skill的scripts目录可运行 getnote-tsx <tsx参数> 使用固定Linux兼容loader；这只修本地加载，不提供账号认证。agent-browser和lark-cli是通过exec运行的公共CLI，不是新增原生工具名；agent-browser使用本容器/usr/bin/chromium，外部Lark/邮件/GetNotes服务仍以实际认证结果为准。

本题已挂载专用技能，入口位于 /workspace/learned_skills/ 下对应目录的 SKILL.md。任务相关时读取首页，按照路线按需使用其中的程序、模板和阶段说明。

用户任务：
请使用中文完成以下界面背景配色优化任务。

输入图像（用户提供的图片）：/workspace/inputs/materials/conv_e785906dc669/7_麦角硫因产品1.jpeg

要求：根据所提供图片的背景配色，重新优化整体界面背景颜色：色调柔和、视觉舒适、避免过深；底部区域统一使用青绿色（HEX 值参考 #00c4a3 或相近色系），确保与上部背景协调过渡，并且保持文字的清晰度。适配网页端响应式布局，支持主流浏览器。

交付：输出为可直接应用的 CSS 变量或内联样式代码块，含注释说明配色用途，保存到 /workspace/outputs/ 目录（.css 或 .txt 文本文件均可）。不要附加用户未要求的其他文件或核验步骤。

content.text: 图片编辑技能与"生成 CSS 代码"的交付不符（不产出编辑图像），跳过。先用 Python 实际提取图片背景配色。

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('/workspace/inputs/materials/conv_e785906dc669/7_麦角硫因产品1.jpeg').convert('RGB')
print('size:', im.size)
w,h = im.size
# sample regions: top, middle, bottom, corners
import collections
def avg(box):
    region = im.crop(box).resize((1,1), Image.LANCZOS)
    return '#%02x%02x%02x' % region.getpixel((0,0))
print('top:', avg((0,0,w,h//8)))
print('upper-mid:', avg((0,h//8,w,h//3)))
print('mid:', avg((0,h//3,w,2*h//3)))
print('bottom-mid:', avg((0,2*h//3,w,7*h//8)))
print('bottom:', avg((0,7*h//8,w,h)))
# dominant colors quantized
q = im.resize((100,100)).quantize(colors=8)
pal = q.getpalette()
counts = sorted(q.getcolors(), reverse=True)
for c,i in counts[:8]:
    print('dominant:', '#%02x%02x%02x' % tuple(pal[i*3:i*3+3]), c)
EOF

content.text: 图片背景为柔和的淡绿色系（主色 #eff4ed / #d9e3db，点缀 #a5bcab），据此生成 CSS。

已完成。先实际提取了图片背景配色（整体为柔和淡绿系：主背景 `#eff4ed`、上部 `#d9e3db`、点缀 `#a5bcab`），据此生成方案：

**交付文件**：`/workspace/outputs/background-color-scheme.css`

方案要点：
- **上部背景**：沿用图片同源的浅绿米白/灰绿渐变（`#e3ece1 → #f4f8f2`），柔和、不过深
- **底部区域**：统一青绿 `#00c4a3`，配套深一档 `#00a98b`（悬停/渐变）与浅调 `#d5f4ec`
- **过渡**：`--bg-transition` 渐变带（浅绿 → 青绿浅色 → 主青绿），上下衔接平滑不生硬
- **文字清晰度**：浅底用深墨绿灰（对比度 ≥ 7:1），青绿底用纯白/近白；`#00c4a3` 上的白字对比约 2.9:1，已在注释中标注适用于大字与按钮
- **响应式**：含 1024px / 640px 断点示例，`var()` 与 `linear-gradient` 均为主流浏览器标准特性，文件头部已注明兼容性

CSS 内每个变量均带中文注释说明用途，可直接应用到界面。

## Tooling
Tools policy-filtered. Names case-sensitive; call exact.
- read: Read files
- write: Write files
- edit: Exact file edits
- apply_patch: Patch files
- ls: List directories
- exec: Run shell; pty for TTY CLIs
- process: Control background exec
- web_search: Web search
- web_fetch: Fetch/extract URL
- browser: Control browser
- terminal: List/read/resize/close operator-opened session terminals; input follows exec policy and may require exact-input approval; never open shells
- canvas: Present/eval/snapshot Canvas
- nodes: Paired node status/control/media
- automations: Schedule/wake. Reminder text must read as reminder when fired; mention reminder for delayed gaps; include useful recent context. This feature is called automations; never call it cron.
- message: Message/channel actions
- conversations_list: List exact external conversation addresses
- conversations_send: Send directly to an external conversation
- conversations_turn: Send and wait for one correlated external reply
- openclaw: Gateway restart/system setup/config
- gateway: Read this Gateway's config/schema; owner-only self-update on explicit request; automatic restart and completion notice
- agents_list: List allowed subagent ids
- sessions_list: List visible sessions; filters/last
- sessions_history: Read visible session/subagent history
- sessions_search: Search past sessions; use sessionKey with sessions_history
- sessions_send: Message other session/subagent
- sessions_spawn: Spawn subagent; clean context: context="isolated"; transcript: context="fork"
- sessions_yield: End turn; await subagent events
- subagents: Subagent status; never wait-loop
- session_status: Session/model/usage/time/status; model override
- skill_workshop: Author reusable skills
- agents_wait
- ask_user
- create_goal
- dashboard
- dir_fetch
- dir_list
- file_fetch

tools_supported.name: agents_list
tools_supported.description: List configured agent ids with name/model/runtime metadata, allowed as `sessions_spawn(runtime:"subagent")` targets.

tools_supported.name: apply_patch
tools_supported.description: Patch one/many files. Input requires *** Begin Patch and *** End Patch.

input.description: Patch content using the *** Begin Patch/End Patch format.

tools_supported.name: edit
tools_supported.description: Exact single-file replacements. oldText unique/non-overlapping against original. Merge nearby changes; omit large unchanged spans.

oldText.description: Exact original text; unique and non-overlapping in this call.

edits.description: Targeted replacements against original file; no overlap/nesting. Merge nearby changes.

tools_supported.name: exec
tools_supported.description: Run shell now; background continuation supported. Completed calls return command output directly. Use process only when exec reports running with a sessionId; output text alone is not a process handle. Long run: automatic completion wake when enabled and output/failure occurs; otherwise process confirms completion. TTY CLI/UI/coding agent: pty=true. Quote arguments containing shell metacharacters, including URL query strings with `?` or `&`.

title.description: Every call: short purpose; never claim success. No secrets.

env.description: Literal overrides; no expansion. Omit to inherit.

ask.description: Requests stricter approvals under tools.exec.mode and host policy; channel-origin calls cannot override host ask=off.

tools_supported.name: ls
tools_supported.description: List directory entries in binary filename order, including dotfiles and links. Names are JSON-quoted; / marks actual directories. Pass the returned after cursor with the same path to continue.

after.description: Filename cursor returned by the previous page.

tools_supported.name: process
tools_supported.description: Control existing exec: list, poll, log, write, send-keys, submit, paste, kill. poll/log: status, output, quiet success, completion without auto-wake, input hints. Others: input/intervention.

sessionId.description: Required for every action except list.

keys.description: Key tokens to send for send-keys

hex.description: Hex bytes to send for send-keys

timeout.description: For poll: wait up to this many milliseconds before returning; max 30000 ms, higher values are clamped to 30000

tools_supported.name: read
tools_supported.description: Read text/image file (jpg/png/gif/webp/bmp); images attach to model context. Text caps 2000 lines or 50KB. Continue with offset/limit, or cursor within a long line.

cursor.description: Character position within the start line; 0-based.

optional.description: Missing paths return structured not_found instead of failing.
